spans.s:
n. (-घः)
Sin.
E.
अघि to go, and असि aff.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
1 A foot.
2 The root of a tree.
E.
हन to kill, and क्रिन् Uṇādi aff. the formative is irregular. See अंह्रि.

m. (-कः)
The root of a tree, being named from a foot; every synonym of a foot, being also that of the root of a tree.
E.
अङ्घ्रि, and नामक name.

n. (-म)
The root of a tree.
E.
अङ्घ्रि a foot or root, and नामन् a name. See the last.

m. (-पः)
A tree. See अंह्रिप.
E.
अङ्घ्रि a root, and प, from पा to drink.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant. See अङ्घ्रिवल्लिका.
E.
अङ्घ्रि, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीप्, the leaves rising from the root.

f. (-का)
A plant, (Hedysarum lagopodioides, Rox.)
E.
अङ्घ्रि, and वल्लिका a pedicle.
